title: The Strong Tower
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
The Strong Tower | Innocent Blood, Courage in Dark Times, Godly Conviction, and Safety in Christ - Proverbs v18:10

The name of the Lord is a strong tower; when fear rises, darkness closes in, and the world seems unsteady, the righteous can run to Him and be safe. From Proverbs v18:10 and Genesis v4:9-11, we are reminded that innocent blood matters to God, sin brings death, and human hearts drift quickly when they turn from His truth.

Yet the Lord still calls us to live with courage, conviction, and compassion. We are our brother’s keeper, and we must value life, stand for what is right, and refuse the compromise that tries to mix God’s way with the world’s way. Even when the hour is dark, God does not lose His power, and His people do not have to lose heart.

Above all, our hope rests in Jesus Christ. Without His innocent blood shed for us, we would have no hope at all. The refuge we need is not found in ourselves, but in the Savior whose sacrifice brings forgiveness, safety, and eternal life to all who flee to Him by faith.
